say.en: My wind gauge! Finally. Bavko never forgets... well, sometimes he forgets.
say.sl: Moj vetromer! Končno. Bavko nikoli ne pozabi ... no, včasih pozabi.

say.en: See how it spins? The wind is wrong today. Win a battle in the windy grass to the south-west, then come back to me.
say.sl: Vidiš, kako se vrti? Veter je danes čuden. Zmagaj v boju v vetrovni travi na jugozahodu, nato se vrni k meni.

say.en: The windy grass is in the south-west. Win one battle there, then come back. Too hard? Train in the meadow first.
say.sl: Vetrovna trava je na jugozahodu. Tam zmagaj v enem boju, nato se vrni. Pretežko? Najprej treniraj na travniku.

say.en: Strong out there, isn't it? And strange. The mail from the outer islands has stopped. Not one letter in days.
say.sl: Tam močno piha, kajne? In čudno. Pošta z zunanjih otokov ne prihaja več. Že več dni niti enega pisma.

say.en: Thank you for the help. Tell Bavko I'll keep watching the sky.
say.sl: Hvala za pomoč. Povej Bavku, da bom še naprej opazovala nebo.

say.en: A grey letter, brought by the wind? Let me read it...
say.sl: Sivo pismo, ki ga je prinesel veter? Naj ga preberem ...

say.en: "The clouds over the far islands are going quiet. Something out there is hungry."
say.sl: »Oblaki nad daljnimi otoki utihujejo. Nekaj tam zunaj je lačno.«

say.en: Go to the lookout, just east of me. Look out over the sea of clouds. Quickly!
say.sl: Pojdi na razgledišče, malo vzhodno od mene. Poglej čez morje oblakov. Hitro!

say.en: The lookout is just east of me. Go and look out over the clouds.
say.sl: Razgledišče je malo vzhodno od mene. Pojdi in poglej čez oblake.

say.en: That was no storm. Storms don't eat.
say.sl: To ni bila nevihta. Nevihte ne jedo.

say.en: Take the letter back to Bavko. He needs to see this.
say.sl: Odnesi pismo nazaj Bavku. To mora videti.

say.en: Bavko must see that letter. Hurry back to the post.
say.sl: Bavko mora videti tisto pismo. Pohiti nazaj na pošto.

say.en: I watch the far clouds every day now. If that thing comes back, we'll see it in time.
say.sl: Zdaj vsak dan opazujem daljne oblake. Če se tisto vrne, ga bomo pravočasno opazili.

say.en: Hm. The wind turns east again. I don't like it.
say.sl: Hm. Veter se spet obrača proti vzhodu. To mi ni všeč.
